summary: Release C + E tested end-to-end. Backend: 42 tests (the 7 in test_release_ce, 8 new edge-case tests in test_release_ce_extended, plus the Release A/B regression suites). 39 pass and 3 fail; all 3 failures are real security/logic bugs in invitations. Regression A/B: all pass. UI: owner activation (Customer Activation tab -> Verify & invite owner -> held link -> history), the public /accept-invite page (wrong email, success, reuse), Settings -> Team invites as owner and manager (role options, site picker, held link, Send new link, Cancel) and Master Admin -> Finance -> Commercial lifecycle were all run in the browser. Found and FIXED a page-crashing bug: any API error on /accept-invite (e.g. wrong email) crashed React because formatApiError returns an object. Found 2 integration gaps: the Products panel and the Gym Floor device setup cannot be reached by customer owners in the UI.

critical.issue: Two owner invites for different emails can be pending for the same org. Creating one does not supersede the other, because superseding only matches the same email. After owner A accepts and the org is activated, owner B's link still works: org ends up with 2 owner users (verified: 200, owners=2). accept()/_activate_org never re-checks that the org is still pending_activation.

Reissue does not check org activation status. After the customer is activated, reissuing an older pending owner invite returns 200 with a fresh owner link. invite_owner has the 409 'already activated' guard but reissue (SI.reissue) bypasses it.

Permission gaps: (1) a manager can CANCEL the owner's manager invitation (200; resend is blocked, cancel is not). (2) A manager restricted to Site A can RESEND a staff invite scoped to Site B (200) and receives the new one-time held link for a site they don't manage. Need the same role and allowed_site_ids checks as invite_staff.

minor.issue: A site-restricted manager must send allowed_site_ids, otherwise the call returns 403. But see the UI bug: the UI never sends them when the manager has only 1 site. Suggest the backend defaults to the manager's own sites when none are given.
The endpoints don't restrict kind to owner_activation, so Pulse admins can revoke/reissue staff invites through the owner endpoint. Low risk.

The claim is not released when send_trial_ending_email fails, so that trial never gets a reminder. The key date comes from min(module_trials.expires_at), while trial_lifecycle/lifecycle_emails use org.trial_ends_at. If those dates differ, the dedupe misses.
The wrong-email lockout counter is read-modify-write (not atomic). Concurrent wrong attempts can exceed 5 before the lock. Low risk.
Handover entries a manager posts without a site_id (site_id null) are invisible to every site device. Probably intended, but worth confirming.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: setErr(formatApiError(...)) stored an object {title, detail, status} and rendered it, which crashed the page with 'Objects are not valid as a React child'. This hit any error on /accept-invite (wrong email, weak password) and would hit the owner-invite dialog (e.g. 409 Sage hold) and Products panel errors. Changed to use f.detail || f.title. Verified that the wrong-email message now displays.

'Send new link' (reissue) throws away the response. While emails are held, the new one-time link is never shown, and the old link is superseded, so the admin is left with no usable link. act() also has no error handling (unhandled rejection).

InviteSitePicker hides itself when the user sees fewer than 2 sites. manager@isodemo.com (only site A) therefore gets no picker, sends allowed_site_ids=[], and gets a 403 'You can only invite people to the sites you manage'. Restricted managers with one site can never invite staff from the UI. Verified in the browser.
Still calls /organization/invite but throws away the held link, shows 'Invite sent' even though nothing was emailed, always offers Manager (managers get a 400), and has no site picker.

integration_issues.issue: ProductSubscriptionsPanel is only mounted in pages/AccountPanel.js. Navbar renders AccountPanel ONLY for is_master_admin/is_pulse_admin. Customer owners get AccountSettingsModal, whose Plan & Billing (AccountSettings/billing) has no Products panel and no calls to /account/billing/modules. Owners therefore cannot cancel or keep products from the UI.

GymFloorManagerTab (device list + site selector) is only mounted in MODPortal/MODProDashboard. LiteDashboardPage removed the gym-floor tab (iter 241 comment), so LITE/PRO commercial owners have no UI to create or disable site devices. The backend was fully tested by API. UI selectors gym-floor-devices and gym-floor-setup-site were not reachable in the browser.

design_issues.screen: Owner invite dialog (Manage, with invite history)
issues: Content overflows the dialog horizontally. The email input, close (X) button and 'Cancel' history button are clipped on the right. The history row span uses 'truncate' inside a flex row with no min-w-0, and the long email plus buttons push the width out.
The 'Company Code' card still says 'Share this code with staff to join your organization' with an empty code pill. That contradicts Release C (secure invites replace company codes).

action_items: In secure_invites.accept (owner_activation), re-check org.onboarding_status == pending_activation (409/410 otherwise). When one owner invite is accepted, supersede all other pending owner_activation invites for the org. Consider superseding other-email pending owner invites when creating a new one.
In reissue for owner_activation, refuse with 409 once the org is activated (same guard as invite_owner).
cancel_invite: managers may only cancel staff invites within their allowed_site_ids. resend_invite: also enforce the manager's site scope.
OwnerInviteDialog: show the reissue response link (held) and handle errors in act().
InviteSitePicker/SettingsTab: for restricted managers, auto-select their single site (or have the backend default to the manager's sites).
Mount ProductSubscriptionsPanel in AccountSettingsModal Plan & Billing for owners.
Expose GymFloorManagerTab (or the Setup panel) in the LITE/PRO dashboard (e.g. under Staffing).
OnboardingWizard step 3 invite: show the held link, use role options by user role, include the site picker.
Fix owner invite dialog overflow (min-w-0 on the history span / wrap buttons). Remove or reword the Company Code card.
critical_code_review_comments: secure_invites._activate_org is not idempotent against multiple owner invites. owner_id is only set if missing, but a second owner user is still created.
Master-admin revoke/reissue accept any invitation kind; restrict them to owner_activation.
AcceptInvitation only reads the token on mount. A same-tab hash change to a different token keeps the old state (minor).
routes/gym_floor.py is ~750 lines; consider splitting device management out.

commercial summary MRR counts every org with modules.X.source=='paid' and enabled, including invoiced/admin-edited docs that set source=paid without a Stripe sub. Consider also requiring module_subscriptions.X.stripe_subscription_id.

success_rate.frontend: ~70% (activation, accept page, owner team invites and commercial report work; restricted-manager invite broken; Products panel and gym-floor setup unreachable for customers)

seed_data_creation: Synthetic TST orgs only, all purged by id. UI test org tst-ui-d5da59fe was purged. Two TST staff invitations created in iso-demo-org (tst.ui.staff.iso1@example.com) and the activation_events row 'first_staff_invited' they triggered (id 0f14f152...) were deleted by id, so the demo org is back to its original state. No emails sent; INVITATION_EMAILS_LIVE not set.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest tests/test_release_ce.py tests/test_release_ce_extended.py (the 3 failing extended tests encode the expected secure behaviour). UI auth: mint tokens with tests.test_sage_sicon_customer_import._token(email) and set localStorage 'token'. Admin tokens seemed to stop working after ~8-10 min, so re-mint before each browser run. Settings Team dialog opens at /dashboard?settings=1. Customer Activation is at /master-admin?section=onboarding&tab=activation, Commercial report at /master-admin?section=commercial. In the role Select, filter options by exact text: 'Manager - ... invite staff' also contains 'staff'.
rca of the issue: Accept page crash: formatApiError() returns {title, detail, status}, but the new Release C/E components passed it straight to setErr/setMsg and rendered it as a React child. Second-owner bug: create_invitation only supersedes pending invites with the same (org, email), and accept() validates only the invitation state, not the org's activation state.
